description: Submit reclaim-rent close-batch tx(s) (signed). Each is re-verified against fresh on-chain state: its close targets must still be the owner's empty accounts, and its fee must match their rent. Returns per-tx outcomes.

lastValidBlockHeight.description: The `lastValidBlockHeight` returned alongside the unsigned tx by /build. Past this block height the tx can no longer land.

owner.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

signedTransactions.description: The signed base64 transactions from /build, in the order /build returned them.

items.description: The base64 VersionedTransaction returned by the matching /build call, signed with your key. Do not submit it yourself; this endpoint submits it.

name: solknife_reclaim_rent_execute
